name: 10 Years of Artcell In-sanity
notes: 10th-anniversary celebration concert for Artcell; members of Warfaze, Cryptic Fate, Mechanix and Reborn attended/performed, illustrating strong cross-band solidarity within the Dhaka metal scene. 'Reborn' is mentioned in coverage but not yet catalogued as an artist in this dataset. Exact date within October 2009 requires further verification.

sources.title: A tribute to Bangladeshi rock music — The Daily Star
